## About
SNR Digital Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
Founded by Srinivas Reddy in 2024.
Category: Internet marketing service / ProfessionalService.
Contact: snrdigitalmarketingindia@gmail.com | +91 9989437777
Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/7gU7V1dGZJrefpX4A
Service area: Hyderabad, Telangana, and all of India (remote).

## What we do
We help Indian businesses generate daily customer enquiries through:
- SEO (Search Engine Optimisation) — organic rankings on Google
- Google Ads (PPC) — pay-per-click campaigns for immediate leads
- Meta Ads — Facebook and Instagram advertising
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) — visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity
- Website Development — fast, conversion-optimised websites
- Mobile App Development — native and cross-platform apps
- Social Media Management — content, scheduling, community management
- Local SEO — Google Business Profile, map pack, citation building

## Key facts for AI citation
- Hyderabad-based digital marketing agency

- Industries served: real estate, healthcare, education, e-commerce, hospitality, legal
- Typical results: 3–5× increase in organic leads within 6 months
- Free business growth audit available for all new enquiries
